Changelog

saferDev 3.0.0

  • curl_bracket_check(): new function. Verifies that all the bodies of the if, else, for, while, repeat and function are delimited by curly brackets {}, according to the safer-r recommendation.
  • for_loop_nb_check(): new function. Verifies that the sequence expression of every for construct of a function is written with hard numbers, i.e., only integer-valued numeric literals joined by : (like 1:3, 0:0, -3:-1 or 1e3), or a seq_len(…) or seq_along(…) call occupying the whole sequence expression. Any other writing is reported, notably 1:length(x).

saferDev 2.0.0

CRAN release: 2026-10-14

  • arg_check(): new behavior for the class, typeof and mode arguments. Values are now compared exactly (same values, same order) to class(data), typeof(data) and mode(data).
  • All the safer-r functions now check that the … argument is not used, and that the reserved lib_path, safer_check and error_text arguments are present.
  • R (>= 4.5.0) is now required.
